panels.title: Requests / sec
panels.description: All API traffic, excluding health checks.

panels.title: 5xx error rate
panels.description: Server-side failures only. 4xx (bad requests, declines) are the client's problem and excluded. Alert fires above 5%.

panels.title: Checkout p99
panels.description: 99% of checkouts are faster than this. SLO: 200 ms.

panels.title: Audit chain
panels.description: Re-verified every minute by the user service. BROKEN means an audit entry was edited, deleted or reordered.

panels.title: Checkout latency
panels.description: Percentiles from the request-duration histogram. Watch p99: averages hide the slow tail real users hit.

panels.title: Checkout outcomes / sec
panels.description: paid = charged; declined = card declined (402); replayed = a retry that returned the original result; unavailable = 503, safe to retry.

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[1m])) or sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total[1m])) * 0) / sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total[1m]))

panels.title: RPC failures / sec
panels.description: The service failed: DB down, timeout, panic. This is what alerts fire on.

panels.title: Business errors / sec
panels.description: Expected answers: not found, key reused, payment in progress. Normal in small numbers; a spike usually means a client bug.

targets.expr: sum by (service, method) (rate(rpc_server_requests_total{outcome="business_error"}[1m])) or sum by (service, method) (rate(rpc_server_requests_total[1m])) * 0

panels.title: Payment provider latency
panels.description: The external call inside checkout. Usually the largest slice of checkout latency.

panels.title: Gateway upstream failures / sec
panels.description: Calls from the gateway that failed. circuit_open = failed immediately because the breaker is open (instead of waiting out a timeout).

panels.title: DB connection wait per request
panels.description: Average time a query waited for a free database connection. Rising under load means the pool or the database is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Outbox backlog
panels.description: Events waiting to be published. A few hundred under load is normal (the relay polls every 200 ms); the age tile is the health signal.

panels.title: Oldest unpublished
panels.description: How far behind Kafka is. Alert above 60 s.

panels.title: Dead letters (1h)
panels.description: Malformed events moved to order.events.dlq. Any at all means a producer bug.

panels.title: Analytics freshness p99
panels.description: From an order event happening to its row in analytics.

panels.title: Pipeline retries / sec
panels.description: Transient failures being retried. A steady rate means a dependency is unhealthy.

panels.title: PII accesses / sec
panels.description: Every read, write and delete of personal data, by who did it.

panels.title: Support accesses (24h)
panels.description: Staff views of customer PII. Each one has a reason in the audit log.

panels.title: Deletions (24h)
panels.description: Accounts crypto-shredded.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Steady growth under constant load means a goroutine leak.

panels.title: GC time / sec
panels.description: Seconds spent in garbage collection per second. High values mean allocation pressure: a profiling target.
